campbell.title: Campbell City Council — October 6, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council's agenda for this meeting covers arrangements for temporary legal services while the city attorney position is in transition. It also includes items on compensation and working conditions for unrepresented employees (confidential, classified management, and unclassified management staff), as well as a proposed market adjustment to the city manager's salary.
keyTopics: Temporary legal services during the city attorney transition
Compensation and working conditions for unrepresented confidential, classified management, and unclassified management employees
Market adjustment to the city manager's salary

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — October 7, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council's October 7, 2026, agenda includes routine items like meeting minutes, check registers, and a Treasurer's Report, alongside several notable policy items. These include a major budget amendment for the Hakone Gardens Koi Pond renovation, a new no-parking zone on Chester Avenue, a decision on the city's long-term law enforcement provider, a review of animal care service options, and a public hearing on annual code updates.
keyTopics: Budget amendment of $2,500,000 for the Hakone Gardens Koi Pond Renovation project
No Parking Anytime zone proposed for a section of Chester Avenue near Arcadia Palms Drive
Discussion and determination of the city's long-term law enforcement provider, including a possible agreement with Los Gatos Monte Sereno Police Department
Comparison of regional animal care providers, with direction sought on continuing with San Jose Animal Care and Services or exploring alternatives
Public hearing on annual code updates covering appeals scheduling, City Commissioner qualifications, and business record retention

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — October 13, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council's agenda for October 13, 2026, lists routine financial and administrative items alongside several resolutions on infrastructure project completions, a residential electrification rebate program, and Below Market Rate housing guidelines. The agenda also includes a review of the Commission and Committee Handbook and an update on Ada's Cafe at the Community Center.
keyTopics: Resolution to appropriate $78,000 from the general fund for a residential electrification rebate program
Resolution approving Below Market Rate (BMR) For-Sale and Rental Housing Guidelines, with a CEQA exemption finding under Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3)
Resolutions accepting completion of two public works projects: sanitary sewer spot repairs/CCTV inspections and the FY2024-25 Annual Streets Project by O'Grady Paving
Adoption of an updated Conflict of Interest Code for staff and commissioners
Review of the Commission and Committee Handbook, with an update on Ada's Cafe at the Community Center

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — October 6, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council's October 6, 2026, agenda listed routine business, including approval of minutes from prior meetings, financial reports, and a tree services bid matter. The agenda also included a proposed update to the Town's purchasing policy and the Finance Commission's 2026 work plan.
keyTopics: Relieving Denali Tree Services of its bid due to a bidder's mistake
First Amendment to an agreement authorized for Town Manager execution
Finance Commission's updated 2026 work plan
Resolution amending the Town Purchasing Policy (Policy 4-06)
July 2026 expenditure and revenue reports

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — October 14, 2026
san-jose.summary: This is a planning meeting of San José's Rules and Open Government Committee, where members review and finalize upcoming City Council agendas for October 20 and October 27, 2026. The agenda also lists a few standalone items, including a funding approval for a Rotary Club of San Jose Foundation project and an excused-absence request.
keyTopics: Review and finalization of the October 20, 2026, Council agenda, including possible new items and time-certain scheduling
Review of the October 27, 2026, draft Council agenda, including possible new items and time-certain scheduling
Public record review covering October 1–8, 2026
Approval of District 9 Strong Neighborhoods/SAP funds for the Rotary Club of San Jose Foundation
Retroactive approval of a Council member's travel and excused absence

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Council Neighborhoods Committee — October 15, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The agenda for this Mountain View Council Neighborhoods Committee meeting indicates that City staff were set to attend to answer questions from neighborhoods. Residents were invited to submit questions in advance online, and the agenda otherwise consists of standard procedural notices about public participation and accessibility.
keyTopics: City staff attendance to answer neighborhood questions
Option for residents to submit questions in advance via an online form

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — October 6, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council agenda for October 6, 2026, includes several recognitions (Little League All-Stars, Indigenous Peoples' Day, Friends of the Library Week, and a week against hate), along with routine approvals and contract items. The agenda also lists public hearings on nonfunctional turf watering restrictions, a possible service worker retention ordinance, and public art for the Lakewood Park renovation.
keyTopics: Public hearing and introduction of an ordinance implementing AB 1572 to prohibit potable water use for irrigating nonfunctional turf, with the action found exempt from CEQA under Guidelines Section 15307
Discussion and possible action to introduce a Service Worker Retention Ordinance
Approval of public art for the Lakewood Park renovation

Amendment to increase a contract with WSP USA Inc. for environmental consulting at the SMaRT Station and Sunnyvale Landfill, raising the cap to $385,000 and extending the contract through October 2028
Authorization to negotiate and execute a PG&E easement over a portion of the Clean Water Facility (formerly Water Pollution Control Plant)

cupertino.title: Cupertino Teen Commission — October 14, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino Teen Commission's agenda for October 14, 2026, lists presentations on a Silicon Valley Clean Energy education sponsorship program, cybersecurity awareness, and a youth-led organization called Food Lifts. The agenda also includes approval of prior meeting minutes and selection of the Chair and Vice Chair for 2026-2027.
keyTopics: Silicon Valley Clean Energy education sponsorship program
Cybersecurity awareness presentation
Food Lifts, a youth-led organization, featured in the Teen Commission Highlight Program
Approval of September 9, 2026, meeting minutes
Selection of 2026-2027 Chair and Vice Chair

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — October 6, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council's agenda for October 6, 2026, includes a report and possible Council action affirming pedestrian access restrictions on parts of Lawrence and San Tomas Expressways, and a staff presentation seeking Council input on new policies for data center development, including water use and grid support participation. The evening also includes a joint dinner meeting with the Parks and Recreation Commission and several proclamations for awareness observances.
keyTopics: Report and potential Council action to affirm pedestrian access restrictions on portions of Lawrence and San Tomas Expressways
Staff presentation and request for Council input on updated city policies for new data center development, covering water usage and demand-side grid support participation
Joint dinner meeting with the Parks and Recreation Commission
Proclamations for Breast Cancer Awareness Month, Domestic Violence Awareness Month, and United Against Hate Week

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council's September 15, 2026, agenda listed several financial and infrastructure items, including a federal housing grant plan, a red light camera safety program, and bond refinancing for the former redevelopment agency. The agenda also included a review of the Milpitas Community Center's physical condition.
keyTopics: Approval of the Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Presentation on the Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program
Presentation on the condition of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolution from the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency board regarding sale and issuance of refunding bonds

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Human Relations Commission Meeting — October 8, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Human Relations Commission agenda for this meeting lists three items: a discussion of the proposed 2027 City Council meeting schedule and a citywide list of significant dates, a presentation and decision on funding priorities for the FY 2028 Human Services Resource Allocation Process (HSRAP), and consideration of HOA fee stabilization and affordability protections for owners of below-market-rate homes.
keyTopics: Proposed 2027 City Council meeting schedule and citywide dates of significance list
Priority-setting for FY 2028 Human Services Resource Allocation Process (HSRAP) funding
HOA fee stabilization and affordability protections for below-market-rate homeowners
